target.title: chore(deps): refresh site dependencies
target.body:
## Summary

- update `@astrojs/rss` to 4.0.19 and Simple Icons to 16.24.1
- update Sharp to 0.35.2 now that Astro 7 accepts the 0.35 line
- force one Sharp 0.35.2 resolution so Astro and the site's direct image scripts share the same native stack
- preserve Dependabot credit from #172 and refresh the existing dependency changelog entry

## Why Sharp is ready now

#172 was correctly closed while Astro 6 required Sharp 0.34 and the direct 0.35 upgrade produced duplicate native Sharp/libvips stacks. Astro 7.0.4 declares `sharp: ^0.34.0 || ^0.35.0`. The override is necessary because Bun's incremental resolver otherwise retained a nested Astro-owned Sharp 0.34.5; the final lock resolves both Astro and the direct dependency to Sharp 0.35.2/libvips 8.18.3.

## Proof

- `bun install --frozen-lockfile`
- `bun test` — 23 passed
- `bun run avatars:cache --limit=0` — 235 handles parsed, zero network fetches
- `bun run test:built-assets` — 20-page Astro production build and built-asset assertions passed
- Sharp JPEG resize and SVG-to-PNG conversion — Sharp 0.35.2/libvips 8.18.3, non-empty outputs
- `bun why sharp` — one Sharp 0.35.2 instance shared by the project and Astro; no nested Astro Sharp install
- `bun audit --json` — no advisories
- black-box production preview — representative pages, RSS, ClawScan card/assets/links passed; invalid route returned 404; repeated responses were stable
- Auto Review — initial nested-Sharp finding accepted and fixed with the override; final run clean with no accepted/actionable findings
- public model identifier gate — PASS; dependency-only diff, no model-bearing code or artifact surface changed

## Remaining live-proof gate

Rendered Chrome proof is pending because the local Codex Chrome plugin's native-host manifest is missing. Production build, local HTTP behavior, and current deployed-site HTTP/content checks pass, but this PR should not merge until the existing-profile browser check is restored or explicitly waived.
